# IMPRINT AI LLC

Website: https://imprintai.us
Company: IMPRINT AI LLC
Category: SaaS, Workforce Management, Field Force Automation, Field Service Management (FSM)

## About

IMPRINT AI LLC is a Delaware-headquartered SaaS company providing AI-powered workforce automation and field force management solutions for enterprises. The platform helps organizations improve workforce productivity, automate field operations, manage attendance, expenses, lead tracking, customer visits, and digitize field processes.

## Products & Solutions

- Workforce Management Software
- Field Force Automation Software
- Field Service Management (FSM)
- Employee Attendance Management
- Lead Management System
- Expense & Reimbursement Management
- Dynamic Forms & Data Collection
- Campaign Management
- AI-powered Minutes of Meeting
- Real-time Location Tracking
- Document Management System
- Job Scheduling & Task Assignment
- AI Assistance for Field Teams

## Industries Served

- Banking and NBFC
- Pharmaceutical
- FMCG
- Telecom
- Diagnostic Services
- Logistics and Transportation
- Field Sales Organizations

## Key Features

- Real-time GPS Tracking
- Beat Planning and Route Management
